Anamolies of Mendeleev's periodic table: Following are some disadvantage of Mendeleev's periodic table:

Position of hydrogen: Position of hydrogen in this periodic table is controversial because a. hydrogen behaves like alkali metals as well as like halogens. Thus it can be placed with alkah metals as well as with halogens.

Position of isotopes: The atoms of same element having same atomic number but different in b. mass number are called isotopes. Example- hydrogen will need three positions because there are three isotope of hydrogen but it is not in periodic table.
